proyecto-1.title: Project Management System - AMG
proyecto-1.shortDescription: Management system for managing projects carried out by the Maya Guatemala Association - AMG.
proyecto-1.fullDescription: The Association managed its social projects and beneficiaries using scattered Excel spreadsheets, leading to data duplication, lack of budget control, and slow reporting. As a solution, I developed a complete web system that centralizes project management by phases, beneficiary census, budget execution, and evidence uploading, with exportable report generation in PDF and Excel. The system implements secure authentication, role-based access control, and audit logs, ensuring data integrity. As a result, the organization eliminated data dispersion, gained real-time visibility over its projects, and reduced report generation from days to seconds.

proyecto-2.title: MAGA Event Manager - PURULHÁ
proyecto-2.shortDescription: Web system to register, track, and map training sessions, deliveries, and aid distributed by the MAGA regional office in Purulhá.
proyecto-2.fullDescription: The regional office of the Ministry of Agriculture in Purulhá managed its field activities with Excel, Word, and paper, causing data duplication, loss of historical information, and delays in report preparation. A web system was developed that centralizes the registration of training sessions, deliveries, and aid linked to beneficiaries and communities, with a responsive form for mobile capture. It includes an interactive map that visualizes activities by community with real-time filters, exportable report generation in Word and PDF, and a user module with role-based access control and an audit trail. As a result, the office eliminated the use of manual records, improved the traceability of its operations, and reduced report generation time.
features: Centralized registration of field events and activities
Interactive map of activities by community and region
Automatic exportable reports in Word and PDF
Offline mode for field data capture
